name: Email Tagging (Pilot)
description: Pilot: classify an inbound email into one of four routing categories (financial, actionable, informational, other). Single llm_only generation node against TermNorm /matches, exact-match scoring. Mirrors the live n8n subject-classifier-LM tagging decision.

llm_only.description: Direct LLM generation: read the email, emit one category label. reasoning_effort floored at low — the optimizer can raise it within the allowed set if it pays.
